description: List the US and Canadian jurisdictions Juriset covers, or find one by name. The other Juriset tools take slugs, not names. Each entry has the slug, name, level (`country`, `state`, `province`, `county` or `city`) and parent. Examples: `Washington` or `WA` → `us-wa`; `Alberta` → `ca-ab`; the federal levels are `us` and `ca`. Omit `query` for all of them. Reads the registry; no rule lookup.

query.description: A name, postal abbreviation or slug, any case: `Washington`, `WA`, `us-wa`. Omit to list every jurisdiction.

name: list_jurisdictions
title: Find a jurisdiction
